machineSummary: The EV Care Service Plan is a prepaid maintenance package for electric vehicles available in 3-year and 5-year options, covering scheduled servicing, battery health checks, and roadside assistance to control long-term ownership costs.
shortAnswer: A prepaid maintenance plan for electric vehicles covering scheduled servicing, battery health checks, and roadside assistance over a multi-year period.
keyFacts: Covers scheduled servicing and battery health checks
Can be purchased at vehicle delivery or within first year of ownership
Designed to control long-term ownership costs
